versions.name: Fire Mountain Scout Camp
versions.address: Fire Mountain Scout Camp, Mount Vernon, WA 98274

features.note: Run together with the COPE program.
Mountain biking alongside the camp's mountain-boarding programme.
The Janicki Shelter at the heart of camp.
Lake Challenge at the heart of camp, with a sandy swim beach.
A tandem zip line over a thousand feet long.

versions.summary: Resident camp in the North Cascades foothills near Mount Vernon, Washington, featuring a strong first-year program and mountain biking trails, plus a dining hall, waterfront, shooting sports, climbing, COPE, and STEM offerings.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Unconfirmed codes inherited from camp-finder's frontend fixture data were removed 2026-07-27: camp-finder recorded these camps as fixture data for frontend development, not a live scrape, and no reachable source attests the removed codes. Generic amenities (dining hall, waterfront) are kept — this camp's page is a stub, so its silence about them is not evidence. Distinctive facilities a camp page would advertise are not. Website corrected 2026-07-27: https://www.mountbakerbsa.org/fire-mountain no longer serves this camp (dead, or redirecting to an unrelated page); now https://mountbakerscouting.org/firemountain/. Only `stem` was removed here: the camp's resident-camp page (cited) states its programme outright — "COPE/Climbing (newer High COPE and 1000+ foot tandem zipline) ... Mountain Boarding and Mountain Biking" — which attests `cope` and `mountain_biking`, and STEM appears nowhere. `mountain_biking` was briefly removed on 2026-07-27 by reading only the council's stub landing page, and restored the same day from the page already in these sources.
